title: merging pixel art assets together
author: Rsloth
selftext:
I’ve been working hard on a merge feature for AI generated pixel art that lets you reskin or reimagine an existing game asset using another asset as visual inspiration.

In this example, I take one pixel art asset and merge it with the style/design elements of another. The AI generates a new asset based on the combination rather than simply copying either one.

The goal is to make it much faster to create **consistent pixel art game assets, variations, and reskins** while keeping a coherent visual style across your game.

This could be useful for things like:

* Creating variations of existing game assets
* Reskinning sprites and objects
* Combining visual elements from different assets
* Generating new pixel art from existing references
* Building larger, more consistent game asset libraries

Still experimenting with the feature, but I think this could be a pretty powerful workflow for AI-assisted pixel art and game development.
